parameters.name: FeatureName
parameters.description: Filters the results by feature name.

parameters.name: FeatureViewIds
parameters.description: The feature view IDs by which to filter the results.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the PAI-FeatureStore instance. Call the ListInstances API to obtain it.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Filters the results by feature view name.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description: The sort order. Valid values: `Desc` (descending) and `Asc` (ascending).

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the results to return.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of feature views to return on each page.

parameters.name: ProjectId
parameters.description: The project ID. You can obtain this ID by calling the `ListProjects` operation.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description: The field by which to sort the results.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
Filters the results by type. Valid values:

● `Batch`: batch feature

● `Stream`: stream feature
